transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure on my house is just about paperwork and missed payments. But I know that's not true. The bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job—they've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They keep showing me all these papers, but no amount of documents changes what I've been seeing going on for almost two years now.
Have you ever heard voices or whispers when no one else was around?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or whispers or anything like that. I'm just talking about real people doing things behind my back. It's not... I'm not hearing things in my head, if that's what you mean.
Over the past few months, how has your mood been feeling?

My mood? It's... I mean, it's fine. I'm not depressed or anything like that. Obviously, I'm pretty stressed out and frustrated because of everything they're doing with my house, but other than that, my actual mood is normal. I'm just trying to keep going to work and deal with this whole mess they created.
Do you have any medical conditions or physical health problems?

No, I don't. Physically, I'm... I'm completely fine. I don't have any medical conditions or anything like that. Like I said, I'm just stressed out from what they're doing with my house, but my actual health is good.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts or actions were being directly controlled by an outside force?

No, definitely not. I... nobody is controlling my thoughts or making me do anything. I'm completely in control of myself. Like I said, the problem is what they're doing to my house, on the outside. My mind is entirely my own.
